title: Laravel Smart Triage
description: A Laravel package that gives Eloquent records semantic triage from one model call: urgency bands carrying their own SLA deadline, routing to a taxonomy, escalation flags, and a confidence gate that separates policy escalation from the model admitting it is unsure. Written against a Judge contract so the model underneath can be swapped. The demo is a repairs service for 50,000 homes where switching the weather re-ranks the queue.
